name: io.github.J-MaFf/s2-netbox-mcp
description: MCP server for LenelS2 S2 NetBox access control via the NBAPI. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the S2 NetBox controller's web interface, e.g. https://netbox.example.internal (no trailing slash or path)
environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to true/1/yes to register the write tools (lock/unlock, add/modify/delete). Unset keeps the server strictly read-only.
environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_ENABLE_WRITES

environmentVariables.description: Set to true/1/yes together with NETBOX_ENABLE_WRITES to additionally register the 11 destructive (delete/remove) tools
environmentVariables.name: NETBOX_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE
